summary: AMTD IDEA Group filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary TGE issued 198,630,381 new Class A ordinary shares to affiliate AMTD Digital to acquire four premium hotel assets (100% AMTD IDEA Tribeca Hotel, 50% veto-bearing interest in Ritz-Carlton Perth operations, 100% AMTD Dao By Dorsett Hornsey London, 80% Upper Regalia Kuala Lumpur) for an aggregate purchase price of US$209,766,000 including underlying debt. Share count was set using TGE's 30-day VWAP for the period ending May 29, 2026. Post-deal, AMTD Digital holds 88.2% of TGE (91.1% voting power), and AMTD IDEA beneficially owns 95.6%. Watch related-party valuation and minority overhang.
